description: Defines classes and functions for logging and informational output within the ANGLE project's shader compiler translator component, including TInfoSinkBase and TInfoSink classes.

classes.name: TInfoSinkBase
classes.description: Provides methods for logging messages, including operator overloads for various data types, and manages an internal string sink.

classes.name: TInfoSink
classes.description: Contains instances of TInfoSinkBase for info, debug, and object logs.

methods.name: fractionalPart
methods.description: Returns the fractional part of a floating-point number.
